name: NFP vs CPI: ZN & ES Intraday Reaction at 8:30 AM ET
description: NFP vs CPI intraday reaction comparison for ZN and ES on 5-min bars. Detects 8:30 AM ET bar via datetime_extract, measures forward returns at +1/+3/+6 bars (5/15/30 min). Per-asset summary table and bar chart; cross-sectional scatter of NFP vs CPI sensitivity per asset. Event markers with signed returns.
source:
# =============================================================================
# NFP vs CPI: ZN & ES INTRADAY REACTION AT 8:30 AM ET
# =============================================================================
# Detects NFP and CPI release days via common_economic_indicators.
# Measures returns across 3 post-release windows: 5-min, 15-min, 30-min.
# Per-asset: summary table (avg |move| + count) + grouped bar chart.
# Cross-sectional: scatter of avg |5-min move| NFP (x) vs CPI (y) per asset.
# Event markers: signed returns at each NFP and CPI event.
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1-Min bars) ===
src = market_data_source()()

# === CONTINUOUS CONTRACT (LiquidityBased + BackwardRatio) ===
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio,
    i_offset=0
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
open_price = cont.o

# === NFP DAY DETECTION ===
nfp_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.NonfarmPayrolls)()
nfp_value = nfp_data.result
nfp_filled = ffill_day(nfp_value)
is_nfp_day = is_valid(nfp_filled)

# === CPI DAY DETECTION ===
cpi_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.CPI)()
cpi_value = cpi_data.result
cpi_filled = ffill_day(cpi_value)
is_cpi_day = is_valid(cpi_filled)

# === 8:30 AM ET BAR DETECTION ===
bar_ts = index()
bar_hour = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_ts)
bar_minute = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.minute, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_ts)
is_830 = (bar_hour == 8) and (bar_minute == 30)

# === FORWARD RETURNS FROM 8:30 BAR (5-min bars: period=1 → 5min, 3 → 15min, 6 → 30min) ===
fwd_1bar = forward_returns(period=1)(close)   # 5-min
fwd_3bar = forward_returns(period=3)(close)   # 15-min
fwd_6bar = forward_returns(period=6)(close)   # 30-min

r_5m = fwd_1bar
r_15m = fwd_3bar
r_30m = fwd_6bar

abs_5m_latched = abs(r_5m)
abs_15m_latched = abs(r_15m)
abs_30m_val = abs(r_30m)

# === NFP FILTERED METRICS ===
is_nfp_event = is_830 and is_nfp_day
nfp_abs_5 = where(is_nfp_event, abs_5m_latched)
nfp_abs_15 = where(is_nfp_event, abs_15m_latched)
nfp_abs_30 = where(is_nfp_event, abs_30m_val)

# === CPI FILTERED METRICS ===
is_cpi_event = is_830 and is_cpi_day
cpi_abs_5 = where(is_cpi_event, abs_5m_latched)
cpi_abs_15 = where(is_cpi_event, abs_15m_latched)
cpi_abs_30 = where(is_cpi_event, abs_30m_val)

# === SIGNED RETURNS FOR EVENT MARKERS ===
nfp_em_5 = where(is_nfp_event, r_5m)
nfp_em_15 = where(is_nfp_event, r_15m)
nfp_em_30 = where(is_nfp_event, r_30m)

cpi_em_5 = where(is_cpi_event, r_5m)
cpi_em_15 = where(is_cpi_event, r_15m)
cpi_em_30 = where(is_cpi_event, r_30m)

# === CROSS-SECTIONAL: Abs 5-min returns for scatter ===
nfp_abs_5_cs = where(is_nfp_event, abs_5m_latched)
cpi_abs_5_cs = where(is_cpi_event, abs_5m_latched)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Summary Table: Avg |Move| NFP vs CPI (per asset) ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Avg Absolute Move: NFP vs CPI at 8:30 ET',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['NFP', 'CPI'],
        col_headers=['|Move| 5min', '|Move| 15min', '|Move| 30min', 'Events'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Release Magnitude',
    order=0
)(nfp_abs_5, nfp_abs_15, nfp_abs_30, nfp_abs_5, cpi_abs_5, cpi_abs_15, cpi_abs_30, cpi_abs_5)

# --- 2. Grouped Bar Chart: NFP vs CPI Avg |Move| by Interval ---
# Stack groups NFP and CPI on x-axis; series names (5/15/30-Min) become legend entries
xy_bars(
    title='Which Release Hits Harder? NFP vs CPI Avg |Move|',
    category='1. Release Magnitude',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg Absolute Return',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5-Min', color=Color.Blue, stack='NFP'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='15-Min', color=Color.Indigo, stack='NFP'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='30-Min', color=Color.Slate, stack='NFP'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5-Min', color=Color.Blue, stack='CPI'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='15-Min', color=Color.Indigo, stack='CPI'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='30-Min', color=Color.Slate, stack='CPI')
    ]),
    order=1
)(nfp_abs_5, nfp_abs_15, nfp_abs_30, cpi_abs_5, cpi_abs_15, cpi_abs_30)

# --- 3. Cross-Sectional Scatter: ZN vs ES Sensitivity to NFP vs CPI ---
# Each asset becomes one point at (avg |NFP 5-min move|, avg |CPI 5-min move|)
# Shows which asset reacts more to which release type
cs_scatter(
    title='ZN vs ES: Which Asset Reacts More to NFP vs CPI?',
    category='2. ZN vs ES Direction',
    x_axis_label='Avg |5-Min NFP Move|',
    y_axis_label='Avg |5-Min CPI Move|',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(x=nfp_abs_5_cs, y=cpi_abs_5_cs)

# --- Event Markers: NFP Releases with Signed Returns ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='NFP Release',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='5-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_nfp_event, nfp_em_5, nfp_em_15, nfp_em_30)

# --- Event Markers: CPI Releases with Signed Returns ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='CPI Release',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='5-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_cpi_event, cpi_em_5, cpi_em_15, cpi_em_30)
